services.name: Banana Boat Rides
services.desc: Zoom across the Naples, FL waves of the Gulf of Mexico aboard our inflatable Banana Boat. A fun, exciting and safe experience for the whole family! Departs daily from the Naples Beachfront on Vanderbilt Beach in-front of the Ritz Carlton Resort or from LaPlaya Beach & Golf Resort. Up to 6 people at a time, suitable for ages 5 and up. If there are less than 6 participants in your group, kindly note that you may be mixed with other guests on this excursion.
